nodes.label: ADR 0034: Unified Subagent Dispatch and Parallel Rules
Dispatch by Work Type Across Five Stages
nodes.rationale: Dispatch unit is work type (implementation/test/review/repair), not process step number; repair returns to the same subagent session so one implementation never gets a second executorship, and the main session only dispatches, harvests and runs interactive skills.

nodes.label: Four Measured Parallel Disciplines
nodes.rationale: Audits quantified the waste: subagent inheritance of the full parent transcript was 42% of session input, idle polling 27% of tokens, cross-phase full snapshot binding 60-90 minutes per session, and repeated reads/runs up to 28x; these four evidence-backed rules are promoted over the SD-11 five-piece set, which is demoted to a parallel clause.
